theorems.name: Submission.p09_af497904fe_ffe_prime_frobenius_congruence
theorems.statement: ∀ (E : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] [IsGalois ℚ E] (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime → ∀ q : Ideal (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E), q.IsPrime → (ℓ : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E) ∈ q → Finite (NumberField.RingOfIntegers E ⧸ q) → ∃ g : E ≃ₐ[ℚ] E, ∀ a : NumberField.RingOfIntegers E, NumberField.RingOfIntegers.mapRingEquiv g.toRingEquiv a - a ^ ℓ ∈ q
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
